title: DreamHack Winter 2007
wikitext:
[http://web.dreamhack.se/index.php?language=en DreamHack] (DH) is the world's largest computer festival. In the winter of [[2007]] DH hosted a [[DreamHack Winter 2007 QuakeWorld Competition|QuakeWorld competition]] with over 25 000 SEK in prizes.
